sourceText: INCIDENT REPORT INC-ICC-2024-0617. Property: ICC / 環球貿易廣場. Location: High-Zone double-deck shuttle lift SL-2, stalled between 55/F and the 100/F Sky Lobby during evening peak. Reported: 2024-06-17 18:42 by a tenant via the intercom, with eight passengers in the upper deck (lift entrapment). Actions: (1) Control Room (ext 3100) confirmed entrapment on CCTV and intercom at 18:43. (2) Duty Manager Peter Chan (陳大文) acknowledged at 18:48 (within 15 minutes) and activated the lift entrapment procedure per SOP-ICC-LIFT-001. (3) Lift maintenance contractor emergency hotline engaged at 18:45; technician on site 18:58. (4) Passengers released at 19:06 via manual levelling to the nearest floor; reassured, no injuries, offered water and escort. (5) Controller fault (door-zone sensor) reset; SL-2 returned to service after a test run at 19:40. (6) Crowd management at the 100/F Sky Lobby during the outage. Escalation met targets: acknowledgement <15 min, passenger release <30 min. Follow-up: monitor SL-2 door-zone sensor; schedule preventive replacement with the lift contractor.

sourceText: INCIDENT REPORT INC-ICC-2024-0803. Property: ICC / 環球貿易廣場. Location: Central chiller plant serving the Mid Zone (L41-72). Reported: 2024-08-03 11:05 - BMS high-temperature alarms on multiple Mid-Zone floors as chilled water supply temperature rose. Nature: chiller plant trip - lead chiller CH-3 tripped on condenser water pump fault during peak summer load. Actions: (1) BMS operator in the Control Room (ext 3100) raised the alarm at 11:05. (2) Chief Engineer Samuel Tong (唐少華) attended the plant room and confirmed CH-3 condenser water pump CWP-3 overload trip. (3) Standby chiller CH-4 sequenced on at 11:22 to restore chilled water to the Mid Zone. (4) CWP-3 overload reset and inspected; CH-3 returned to standby after checks. (5) Duty Manager Peter Chan notified affected tenants of a temporary temperature rise and restoration. Chilled water / HVAC complaint handling followed SOP-HVAC-OFFICE; chiller plant operation followed SOP-ICC-CHILLER-001. Supply temperature recovered to setpoint by 12:10. Follow-up: investigate CWP-3 overload cause; review summer peak chiller sequencing.

sourceText: INCIDENT REPORT INC-ICC-2025-0114. Property: ICC / 環球貿易廣場. Location: main low-voltage switchroom and essential services. Reported: 2025-01-14 15:33 - a brief CLP (China Light & Power) supply dip caused by an external grid fault in West Kowloon. Nature: momentary power dip; no sustained outage. Actions: (1) UPS systems on essential circuits (life-safety, BMS, lifts control, data rooms) rode through the dip with no interruption. (2) Standby emergency diesel generators auto-started and reached ready state within 15 seconds per design; load was not transferred as mains stabilised. (3) Chief Engineer Samuel Tong (唐少華) verified switchroom status, UPS battery health, and generator fuel. (4) Control Room (ext 3100) logged a short lighting flicker on non-essential landlord areas only. (5) Duty Manager Peter Chan confirmed no tenant impact on essential circuits. Power and essential-services response followed SOP-ICC-POWER-001. Follow-up: download UPS and generator event logs; confirm CLP incident reference; schedule the next generator on-load test.

title: SOP - High-Zone Shuttle Lift Entrapment & Evacuation for ICC

extractedFields.appliesTo: ICC Low / Mid / High Zone passenger and shuttle lifts

sourceText:
STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE SOP-ICC-LIFT-001 - HIGH-ZONE SHUTTLE LIFT ENTRAPMENT & EVACUATION FOR ICC. Applies to: ICC / 環球貿易廣場 Low Zone (L9-40), Mid Zone (L41-72), and High Zone (L73-100) passenger and double-deck shuttle lifts to the 100/F Sky Lobby.

LIFT ENTRAPMENT HANDLING STEPS:
1. DETECT & COMMUNICATE. On an entrapment alarm or intercom call, the Control Room (ext 3100) establishes two-way contact with passengers, confirms the car position and passenger count on CCTV, and reassures occupants to stay calm and NOT attempt to force doors.
2. NOTIFY. Control Room notifies the Duty Manager (acknowledges within 15 minutes) and the lift maintenance contractor emergency hotline immediately. Entrapment is always urgent.
3. RELEASE. Only the authorised lift contractor technician (or trained in-house lift attendant) performs the release, by manual levelling the car to the nearest floor and opening doors. Target passenger release within 30 minutes.
4. CARE. Offer water, medical check if needed, and escort passengers to the Sky Lobby or ground; record names if requested.
5. RESTORE. Do not return the lift to service until the fault is identified, reset, and a test run is completed. For High-Zone shuttle lifts, verify the door-zone and levelling sensors.
6. RECORD & FOLLOW-UP. Log the incident, timeline, and fault; raise preventive maintenance with the lift contractor. This is the authoritative lift entrapment and evacuation procedure for ICC shuttle and passenger lifts.
chunkText: SOP-ICC-LIFT-001 High-Zone Shuttle Lift Entrapment & Evacuation for ICC / 環球貿易廣場 (Low Zone L9-40, Mid Zone L41-72, High Zone L73-100 passenger and double-deck shuttle lifts to the 100/F Sky Lobby). Steps: 1) Control Room (ext 3100) establishes two-way contact, confirms car position and passenger count on CCTV, tells occupants not to force doors. 2) Notify Duty Manager (acknowledge within 15 minutes) and lift contractor hotline immediately - entrapment is always urgent. 3) Only the authorised lift contractor / trained attendant releases passengers by manual levelling to the nearest floor; target release within 30 minutes. 4) Offer water, medical check, escort. 5) Do not return the lift to service until the fault is reset and a test run passes; verify High-Zone door-zone and levelling sensors. 6) Log and raise preventive maintenance.

title: SOP - Central Chiller Plant Operation & Emergency Shutdown for ICC

extractedFields.appliesTo: ICC central chiller plant (Low / Mid / High Zone chilled water)

sourceText:
STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE SOP-ICC-CHILLER-001 - CENTRAL CHILLER PLANT OPERATION & EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN FOR ICC. Applies to: ICC / 環球貿易廣場 central chiller plant supplying chilled water to Low, Mid, and High Zone air handling units. Owner: Chief Engineer. Design: N+1 chiller redundancy with lead/lag sequencing managed by the BMS.

NORMAL OPERATION:
1. SEQUENCING. The BMS stages chillers on demand to hold the chilled water supply setpoint; a standby chiller (N+1) is always available for peak summer load.
2. MONITORING. The Control Room BMS operator monitors chilled water supply/return temperatures, condenser water, and chiller/pump status.

CHILLER TRIP / EMERGENCY RESPONSE:
3. On a chiller or condenser-water-pump trip, the BMS sequences on the standby chiller to maintain chilled water; the Chief Engineer attends the plant room.
4. Diagnose the trip (overload, flow fault, high head pressure), reset after inspection, and return the chiller to standby only when safe.
5. If chilled water cannot be maintained, notify the Duty Manager and affected tenants of a temporary temperature rise; tenant HVAC complaints follow SOP-HVAC-OFFICE.

EMERGENCY / PLANNED SHUTDOWN:
6. A full plant shutdown (e.g. for major fault or planned maintenance) requires Chief Engineer approval, tenant pre-notification where planned, isolation of condenser and chilled water circuits, and a controlled restart with sequencing checks. This is the authoritative chiller plant operation and shutdown procedure for ICC.
chunkText: SOP-ICC-CHILLER-001 Central Chiller Plant Operation & Emergency Shutdown for ICC / 環球貿易廣場 (chilled water to Low/Mid/High Zone AHUs). N+1 chiller redundancy with BMS lead/lag sequencing; owner is the Chief Engineer. Normal: BMS stages chillers to hold the chilled water setpoint with a standby chiller for peak summer load; Control Room BMS operator monitors supply/return temperatures, condenser water, chiller/pump status. Chiller trip: BMS sequences on the standby chiller, Chief Engineer attends, diagnoses (overload / flow / high head), resets after inspection; if chilled water can't be held, notify Duty Manager and tenants (HVAC complaints follow SOP-HVAC-OFFICE). Full/planned shutdown needs Chief Engineer approval, tenant pre-notification, circuit isolation, and controlled restart with sequencing checks.

title: SOP - Fire Alarm Response & Phased Evacuation for ICC

extractedFields.appliesTo: ICC all zones (Low / Mid / High) and Sky Lobby
extractedFields.evacuationModel: Phased / zone evacuation with refuge floors

sourceText:
STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE SOP-ICC-FIRE-001 - FIRE ALARM RESPONSE & PHASED EVACUATION FOR ICC. Applies to: ICC / 環球貿易廣場 all zones and the 100/F Sky Lobby. Model: phased (zone) evacuation using designated refuge floors, not simultaneous full-tower evacuation, given the building height.

FIRE ALARM RESPONSE STEPS:
1. ALARM & VERIFY. On a fire services (FS) alarm, the Control Room (ext 3100) identifies the alarm floor/zone and checks CCTV and the FS panel to verify smoke/flame.
2. INVESTIGATE. The Security Manager dispatches the floor warden team to the affected floor and the adjacent refuge floor; occupants on the alarm floor stand by near the protected refuge area while the point is checked.
3. CONFIRM & DECIDE. If a genuine fire is confirmed, initiate phased evacuation of the alarm floor and the floors immediately above and below to refuge floors / exit staircases, and call the Fire Services Department. If false (e.g. burnt food, dust, maintenance), place the zone on hold and reset after verification.
4. LIAISE WITH FSD. The Duty Manager liaises with the Fire Services Department on arrival; the FS system is only reset after FSD acknowledgement.
5. LIFTS. Passenger lifts are recalled per fire mode; firefighters' lifts are reserved for FSD. Do not use shuttle lifts for evacuation unless directed.
6. RECORD. Log the alarm, cause, actions, and FSD reference. This is the authoritative fire alarm and phased evacuation procedure for ICC.
chunkText: SOP-ICC-FIRE-001 Fire Alarm Response & Phased Evacuation for ICC / 環球貿易廣場 (all zones + 100/F Sky Lobby). Model: phased zone evacuation using refuge floors, not full-tower at once, due to building height. Steps: 1) Control Room (ext 3100) identifies the alarm floor/zone, checks CCTV and the FS panel. 2) Security Manager sends the floor warden team to the affected floor and the adjacent refuge floor; occupants stand by near the refuge area. 3) If genuine fire confirmed, phased-evacuate the alarm floor plus the floors above and below to refuge floors / exit stairs and call the Fire Services Department; if false, hold and reset after verification. 4) Duty Manager liaises with FSD; reset FS system only after FSD acknowledgement. 5) Lifts recalled per fire mode; firefighters' lifts reserved for FSD. 6) Log cause and FSD reference.

title: SOP - Typhoon & Severe Weather Readiness for ICC

extractedFields.triggers: Typhoon Signal No. 8+, Black Rainstorm Warning
extractedFields.appliesTo: ICC office tower, podium, and Sky Lobby

sourceText:
STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE SOP-ICC-TYPHOON-001 - TYPHOON & SEVERE WEATHER READINESS FOR ICC. Applies to: ICC / 環球貿易廣場 office tower, podium, and 100/F Sky Lobby. Triggers: Hong Kong Observatory Typhoon Signal No. 8 or above, and Amber/Red/Black Rainstorm Warnings.

PRE-EVENT (T3 / Amber):
1. Secure external and podium areas: remove or tie down loose items, signage, and planters; check window and curtain-wall seals; clear roof and podium drains.
2. Brief the Control Room, security, and engineering; confirm standby generator fuel and sump pump readiness.

SIGNAL No. 8 / BLACK RAINSTORM:
3. Non-essential landlord services scale down; the building remains structurally manned by essential staff (Control Room, security, engineering) on a storm roster.
4. Advise tenants per Hong Kong 'work suspension' norms; sky100 observation deck closes.
5. Monitor for water ingress at the podium, loading bay, and basement; deploy sandbags/pumps as needed; watch BMS for lift, drainage, and power alarms.

RESUMPTION:
6. After signals are lowered, inspect the curtain wall, roof, lifts, and drainage before full reopening; log damage and clear lifts for normal service. Business continuity and tenant communications follow this procedure. This is the authoritative typhoon and severe weather readiness procedure for ICC.
chunkText: SOP-ICC-TYPHOON-001 Typhoon & Severe Weather Readiness for ICC / 環球貿易廣場 (tower, podium, 100/F Sky Lobby). Triggers: HKO Typhoon Signal No. 8+ and Amber/Red/Black Rainstorm Warnings. Pre-event (T3/Amber): secure external/podium areas, tie down loose items and signage, check curtain-wall seals, clear roof/podium drains, confirm generator fuel and sump pumps. Signal No.8 / Black Rainstorm: scale down non-essential services, keep essential storm-roster staff (Control Room, security, engineering), advise tenants per work-suspension norms, close sky100 deck, watch for water ingress at podium/loading bay/basement and deploy sandbags/pumps, monitor BMS for lift/drainage/power alarms. Resumption: inspect curtain wall, roof, lifts, drainage before reopening; clear lifts for service; log damage.

title: SOP - Office Tenant Fit-Out & After-Hours Works Permit for ICC

extractedFields.permitType: Fit-Out Works Permit (+ Hot Work Permit where applicable)

sourceText:
STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE SOP-ICC-FITOUT-001 - OFFICE TENANT FIT-OUT & AFTER-HOURS WORKS PERMIT FOR ICC. Applies to: ICC / 環球貿易廣場 office floors. Purpose: govern tenant fit-out and after-hours works in leased office premises.

1. PERMIT. All fit-out works require an approved Fit-Out Works Permit submitted at least 5 working days in advance, with drawings, contractor list, and programme. Hot works additionally require a Hot Work Permit with a standby fire watch; fire services impairment must be logged.
2. AFTER-HOURS WORKS. Noisy, dusty, or disruptive works are restricted to the after-hours window 19:00-07:00 and require management approval. Chilled water, electrical isolation, or BMS-affecting works must be coordinated with the Chief Engineer.
3. ACCESS & LIFTS. Fit-out contractors enter via the podium goods entrance; material movement uses the designated service/cargo lift with pre-booked slots, not passenger shuttle lifts. Security verifies permits and worker IDs against the approved list.
4. PROTECTION. Lift lobby and common-area protection (hoarding, floor protection) is required before heavy works; debris removal via the cargo lift to the loading bay at booked times.
5. SAFETY. Mandatory PPE, clear fire egress, and no storage in corridors or refuge floors.
6. COMPLETION. Site cleared, protection removed, and permit closed with security and the Management Office. This is the authoritative office fit-out and after-hours works permit procedure for ICC.

title: ICC Office Tenant Handbook - Access, After-Hours AC & Loading (Bilingual)

Q: How do I get after-hours access to my office floor? A: Staff on the registered after-hours list use their access card for the shuttle lift to the Sky Lobby and the tenant-floor lift. Visitors after hours must be pre-registered with the Management Office and signed in at the podium lobby. 辦公時間以外進入: 已登記員工憑門禁卡使用穿梭電梯；訪客須預先於管理處登記。

Q: How do I request after-hours air-conditioning (AC extension)? A: Submit an after-hours air-conditioning (AC extension) request to the Management Office by 16:00 on the same day, stating floor, zone, and hours. Extended chilled water / AC is chargeable per the tenancy schedule. 冷氣加時: 請於當天下午四時前向管理處申請，列明樓層及時段，費用按租約收費。

Q: How do I book the loading dock / cargo lift for a delivery or move? A: All deliveries, moves, and fit-out material use the podium loading dock and the designated cargo/service lift with a pre-booked slot via the Management Office - passenger shuttle lifts are not for goods. 卸貨/貨梯預約: 所有送貨、搬遷及裝修物料須經管理處預約貨運月台及貨梯。

Q: Who do I contact after hours for an urgent building issue? A: Call the ICC Control Room on ext 3100; it dispatches the on-call technician and notifies the Duty Manager (Peter Chan), who acknowledges within 15 minutes.

Q: What counts as urgent? A: Lift entrapment, water leakage, chilled water / AC plant loss, fire alarm, power loss, and gas smell are urgent and handled immediately; non-urgent items are logged for the next working day.
